title: Toward C:open-ended: on fresh seed 3 to T=10000, the 3-component-trait fed vortices with a kind-specific waste keep populating new trait classes at a steady ~3.5 per 1000 t (12 at t=3000, 25 at 4800, 37 at 7500, 47 at 10000) against 19 in the kind-blind twin, and 10 classes take the plurality for the first time after t=3000 against 1
summary: The world of 20261027T1401-c58-vortex-trait3d (3 trait masses copied linearly where the vortex eats, whole-vortex trait-blind mutation of length 0.4 every 50 t, kind-specific waste ew 0.25, sw 0.4) and its kind-blind twin (sw 0: same ecology and mutation draws, gain independent of the trait) on fresh seed 3, T=10000, with that contribution's trait3.py. Kind-specific: classes ever held by >= 3 vortices 8/12/23/47 at t=1500/3000/4500/10000, no slowing over t=4500-10000 (novelty_s3_long.png); distinct dominant classes 13, first-time dominants after t=3000 10, returns 3; 258 persistent splits, max generation 39, daughters within 0.2 of the parent's trait 190/258, trait jumps away from a mutation 1 of 150. Twin: 7/9/10/19; 2 dominant classes, 1 first-time dominant after t=3000; 388 persistent splits, generation 38, 330/388. The trait maps (d3L_s3_spec_maps.png, RGB = trait) show the vortex colours moving from grey through green and purple to pink and teal while the twin's stay near grey.

finding.operator: kind-specific waste on a 3-component heritable trait
finding.control: kind-blind waste twin (sw 0, same draws), fresh seed 3, T=10000
finding.result: classes ever held by >= 3: 47 vs 19 at t=10000, ~3.5 vs ~1.3 per 1000 t over t=4500-10000; first-time dominants after t=3000 10 vs 1

limits: One fresh seed at T=10000 (seeds 1-2 at T=6000 slowed after t~4500: 31 -> 33), 128^2, one parameter point, no dt/2 or grid test, no labkit pack. The negative frequency dependence is written: the waste records the eater's trait and the gain reads it, so escape into unvisited trait cells is what the rule rewards; every trait value has the same intrinsic fitness, so 'new kinds' are new labels that matter only relative to the waste, not new phenotypes, and reviewers may count O as by construction. What the dynamics supply is the heredity (copying and mutation never read the trait), the individuals and their reproduction. The twin also keeps finding new cells (a 3-D random walk), at about a third of the rate. Heredity is weaker in the selective arm (74% vs 85% of daughters keep the class; within-vortex spread 0.04 vs 0.02).
